data.name: Omkara
data.gender_notes: Omkara is used as a unisex name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Omkara is recorded with the meaning “Supreme syllable OM”. Omkara is a Sanskrit, Hindi, etc. name meaning “Supreme syllable OM”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. data.spiritual_meaning: Omkara expresses “Supreme syllable OM”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.

in_sanskrit.name: ॐकार
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The sound form of the Supreme Being or God, representing the Absolute Reality and the Cosmic Vibration. It is the sound of the Universe, the sound of God.

in_hindi.name: ओमकार
in_hindi.long_meaning: ब्रह्मान्द का शब्द रूप अथवा परमात्मा का शब्द स्वरूप, प्राचीन ऋग्वेद से प्रसिद्ध है।

in_tamil.name: ஓம்காரம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: பிரப்பங்களின் ஒலி வகை, அதன் மூலமாக பிறந்த உலகத்தின் ஒலி.

in_telugu.name: ఓంకారం
in_telugu.long_meaning: సర్వస్వరూపమైన పరమాత్మా కే శబ్దస్వరూపం, ప్రాచీన యేజుర్వేద మరియు ఉపనిషద్ సమూహమైన శాస్త్రమైన శబ్దం.

in_marathi.name: Omkara
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Supreme syllable OM
in_marathi.long_meaning: Omkara हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Omkara is the supreme syllable OM, representing the ultimate reality and the universe's essence in Hinduism.

in_bengali.name: Omkara
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Supreme syllable OM
in_bengali.long_meaning: Omkara একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Omkara is the supreme syllable OM, representing the ultimate reality and the universe's essence in Hinduism.
